prepared_by: Claude (chat research), for Technical Compliance Lead
rules: URLs were fetched and read on 11 Nov 2026 on official government domains.
Internal classification is not a legal determination.
Imported as Awaiting source verification; must not raise new-regulation alerts.
coverage_gaps: Vietnam (JUR-0090): Decree 03/2017/ND-CP on casino business (as amended) was found only on commercial legal databases (caselaw.vn, thuvienphapluat.vn, lawnet.vn); no official Government portal (vanban.chinhphu.vn) link was located, so nothing is listed.

Cambodia (JUR-0025): the Commercial Gambling Management Commission site (cgmc.gov.kh) is official but its robots rules block automated retrieval, and no direct link to the Law on the Management of Commercial Gambling (2020) was found; a person must open the site and give the exact law page. Nothing is listed.

Pakistan (JUR-0108): the Prevention of Gambling Act 1977 was found only on non-official copies (a Pakistan Railways Police PDF whose footnote says the Act ceased to have effect for part of its history, and law-firm sites); no pakistancode.gov.pk link was located. Nothing is listed.

Sri Lanka (JUR-0098): the Casino Business (Regulation) Act No. 17 of 2010 is repealed by the Gambling Regulatory Authority Act No. 17 of 2025 (Section 78); most provisions start on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette Order, reported as 1 December 2025. The Gazette Order and the Authority's own website were not located.

Bangladesh (JUR-0057): Public Gambling Act 1867 is repealed by the Gambling Prevention Act 2026 (Act 98 of 2026). The database page is in Bengali, and the page date (1 July 2026) is not labelled as the gazette date.

Nepal (JUR-0110): the listed page is a notice for the Casino Rules 2082 BS and has no PDF or download link. The National Penal Code 2074 (Section 125, gambling) was not found on the Nepal Law Commission site and is not listed.

sources.authority: Legislative and Parliamentary Affairs Division, Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs (Laws of Bangladesh)
sources.notes: Fetched 11 Nov 2026. Gambling Prevention Act 2026 (Act No. 98 of 2026), in force immediately, repeals the Public Gambling Act 1867 (Section 49). Bengali text; English toggle offered by the database.

sources.authority: Parliament of Sri Lanka (Act as printed by the Department of Government Printing)
sources.notes: Fetched 11 Nov 2026. Gambling Regulatory Authority Act No. 17 of 2025, certified 3 Sep 2025, gazetted 4 Sep 2025. Section 78 repeals the Betting on Horse-Racing Ordinance, the Gaming Ordinance and the Casino Business (Regulation) Act No. 17 of 2010. Commencement is by Ministerial Gazette Order.

sources.authority: Nepal Law Commission, Government of Nepal
sources.notes: Fetched 11 Nov 2026. Casino Rules 2082 BS (dated 8 Bhadau 2082) on the official Nepal Law Commission site. Page has no PDF or download link.
